mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Verona City Hall. Tonight features a full moon, and the International Space Station will be visible at 4:12 AM, traveling from the direction of Verona High School in the northwest toward the northeast. Expect an overnight low of 60 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, Highway M will have lane flagging for utility work starting August 31 through September 1. Additionally, September is designated as Suicide Prevention Month, and September 1 is Building Inspector and Code Staff Appreciation Day to honor our local safety guardians.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness or catch Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look for live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Also, mark your calendars for the Verona Area Kids Triathlon on August 30.
On August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop for expired registration and subsequently cited the driver for possession of marijuana after detecting an odor.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
